subject: RFI: SLO measurement, monitoring, and metrics access (StellarPay)
messages:
From: Amir Rahman <amir.rahman@stellarpay.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@stellarpay.com
Date: 2026-02-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: RFI: SLOs, monitoring, and customer metric access

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement asked me to collect some precise answers so we can move the security and procurement review forward. Attached is a short questionnaire but the key items we need clarified here:

- How do you define uptime SLOs (what counts as a failed request)?
- How is latency measured (p50/p95/p99) and at which points in the pipeline (edge vs model execution)?
- What monitoring stacks do you use, and can customers access dashboards or raw metrics?
- What are alerting thresholds and escalation paths for production incidents?
- Data/metrics retention periods and whether historical data is exportable.
- If we need an exception (e.g., for a hard SLO during onboarding), what is the formal request process?

Can you reply with a short RFI response and a sample dashboard screenshot if possible? Procurement would like answers by EOD Friday so we can prepare the contract addendum.

Attached: StellarPay_RFI_SLOs.xlsx (questionnaire)

Best,
Amir Rahman
Procurement Manager, StellarPay
amir.rahman@stellarpay.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Rahman <amir.rahman@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T10:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SLOs, monitoring, and customer metric access

Hi Amir — thanks for the questionnaire. I’m attaching a concise response for procurement and a short summary below. Marissa and Karthik are looped in for technical detail and to provide a dashboard snapshot.

Short answers (high level):
- Uptime SLO: measured as the percentage of successful inference responses (2xx) within request timeout across a rolling 30-day window, excluding planned maintenance windows. Request failures counted: 5xx responses, timeouts at the gateway or runtime, and RPC errors to the model host.
- Latency measurement: we report p50/p95/p99 at two checkpoints: (1) edge (ingress + routing) and (2) model execution (kernel + decode). All latency metrics are measured on server timestamps and include request queueing.
- Monitoring stack & access: we use Prometheus for collection, Grafana for dashboards, and Loki for logs. Customers get a dedicated read-only dashboard in the Redwood Console; we can also provide a short-lived API token or raw Prometheus export on request.
- Alerting & escalation: standard alerts (p95 > threshold, error rate spike, model timeouts) push to PagerDuty and a dedicated on-call rotation (Redwood SRE). We offer optional joint runbook alignment for large customers.
- Retention: aggregated metrics retained at full resolution for 90 days, 1h downsample to 365 days. Historical exports provided as CSV on request.
- SLO exception requests: we have a formal exception process (submit RFE to your Redwood rep — we evaluate business impact, mitigation, and a time-boxed exception with compensating controls).

I’ve attached a formal PDF response (redwood-slo-rfi-response.pdf). Marissa / Karthik — please add a Grafana snapshot and any implementation notes we should send to procurement.

Proposed next step: 30-min walk-through of the dashboard and runbook — are you available Wed/Thu next week?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-slo-rfi-response.pdf

From: Amir Rahman <amir.rahman@stellarpay.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@stellarpay.com
Date: 2026-02-18T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SLOs, monitoring, and customer metric access

Thanks Vivek — that’s helpful. A couple follow-ups from procurement/security:

1) Can you provide a sample Grafana screenshot that mirrors the console view we’d get?
2) Is there an API we can call to pull the raw p95/p99 series for our account for custom reporting?
3) For onboarding, can we have a temporary stricter SLO (e.g., guaranteed p95 < 200ms for first 30 days)? If not, what does the exception process look like operationally?
4) SOC2 evidence request: where would we find monitoring/audit logs that show uptime/incident timelines (or can you provide a pointer to a sample export)?

We’re aiming to close the procurement checklist quickly — a short screenshot + pointer to the API docs would be great.

–Amir

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-19T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: RFI: SLOs, monitoring, and customer metric access — action items

Marissa/Karthik — FYI thread from StellarPay procurement. Requesting: Grafana screenshot, API pointer, and confirmation on onboarding exception process. Can you handle the deliverables below?

Ask list:
- Marissa: export a dashboard snapshot (console + grafana) scoped to the account-level view (redact any unrelated customer data). Attach PNG.
- Karthik: prepare a short note (1–2 bullets) on the Prometheus export API endpoint and how we issue read-only tokens; include a sample curl.
- Both: a one-paragraph description of the exception process we follow (time-box, mitigation, who signs off).

Target: get these back to me by COB tomorrow so I can send a single consolidated response to procurement. If you need engineering to flip a switch for a read-only user, tell me now and I’ll escalate.

Thanks — Vivek

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Rahman <amir.rahman@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-20T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SLOs, monitoring, and customer metric access

Hi Amir — attaching the items you requested and proposing a short walkthrough next week. Summary below; attachments are: grafana-snapshot-stellarpay.png and slo-runbook-summary.txt. The full PDF response is already with procurement (sent earlier).

Summary responses to your follow-ups:
- Grafana screenshot: attached (account-level, read-only view). This is representative of the Redwood Console dashboard we provision per customer.
- Metrics API: we expose a Prometheus-compatible /metrics/export endpoint scoped to each account. Sample: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <read-only-token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics/export?series=p95_latency&start=2026-01-01&end=2026-01-31
- Onboarding exception: we can evaluate a time-boxed SLO exception (e.g., p95 objective tightened for 30 days) via a formal request: (1) customer submits an exception form, (2) Redwood SE/SRE evaluate mitigations, (3) legal signs off on the addendum, (4) we schedule a canary and enable compensating controls. Exceptions are logged and expire automatically.
- SOC2/monitoring evidence: we provide incident timelines and monitoring exports as part of the compliance package; sample export available on request (we provided a pointer in the RFI PDF).

Next steps: propose a 30-min walkthrough on Wed 2026-02-25 10:00 AM PST to demo the live dashboard and review the exception flow. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite (we can include your security and procurement reps).

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- grafana-snapshot-stellarpay.png (image/png)
